title: 2026-bes-lca-tea: coupled techno-economic and climate bound for commodity production in wastewater bioelectrochemical systems (model and data, v1.0.0)
description: Python model (package bescl), configuration, input tables and generated result tables for the article 'Commodity chemicals cannot repay a wastewater bioanode even at its theoretical ceiling, but commodity metals can: a coupled techno-economic and climate bound for bioelectrochemical reduction' (Chen, Khatami and Jiang). The model couples an ideal zero-gap bioelectrochemical cell (10 A m-2, complete Coulombic efficiency, 0.20 V ohmic loss) with a bottom-up levelized stack cost, standard downstream processing and a cradle-to-gate climate balance for thirteen commodity products, solves the break-even value of every lever, runs one-at-a-time sweeps and screens 40 literature products per mole of electrons. python run_all.py regenerates every CSV table in results/tables from the YAML configuration and runs the regression tests. Code: MIT; configuration, inputs and results: CC BY 4.0. No ecoinvent datasets are redistributed; only aggregated characterization factors appear, one number per flow. The figures and documents of the article were produced from these tables with separate scripts that are not part of this archive.
